explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 63 named tracks, current release cuts, adjacent label material and overlooked 2026 catalogue selections across Juno's current techno/electro listings, Boomkat's September 11 new-release field and Limousine Dream's 2026 compilation catalogue. sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Rene Wise's Moving Pressure 07 and Planet Rhythm's What Time Is Love EP were both released 2026-09-10, while Curbside Lambsear's debut arrived 2026-09-11; each supplied differentiated exact-track propositions. https://www.juno.co.uk/products/rene-wise-moving-pressure-07-vinyl/1168066-01/ · https://www.juno.co.uk/products/planet-rhythm-what-time-is-love-ep-vinyl/1172334-01/ · https://boomkat.com/products/put-rings-on-all-my-fingers-to-weigh-down-my-hands

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Belarus-born, Poland-based PRIDI's Nesreh debut and Curbside Lambsear's electronic/post-rock debut supplied roaming, echoing and song-disassembly questions beyond one techno room. https://www.juno.co.uk/products/pridi-nesreh001-vinyl/1127009-01/ · https://boomkat.com/products/put-rings-on-all-my-fingers-to-weigh-down-my-hands

OVERLOOKED / CATALOGUE WINDOW: Vakula's March 2026 Pure Delay debut and Limousine Dream's March 2026 Life Spiral compilation supplied polyrhythmic, acid, dub and off-kilter forms that had not entered STRANGE GAIT's durable history. https://www.juno.co.uk/products/vakula-pulsation-vinyl/1127922-01/ · https://www.juno.co.uk/products/life-spiral-vinyl/1135044-01/
exclusions: Recent Runs 198–206 source fields, every prior ranked lead and alternate, canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, and existing global utility identities were excluded.

The five-run repetition check avoided every placement boundary proposed in completed exploration Runs 198, 201, 202, 203 and 206. Current placements are candidate-specific questions, not a boundary-distribution quota.
Nine leads survived because each has differentiated exact-track evidence and a concrete transition/local-run/long-form question; no list slot was padded.

The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both listener-protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
